description.value: Banana Leaf is Vancouver's original Malaysian restaurant, founded in 1995 and now operating five locations across Metro Vancouver. The menu draws on Malaysian, Indonesian, Singaporean, Thai, Chinese, and Indian culinary traditions, featuring over 40 dishes including roti canai, beef rendang, and fresh seafood preparations. It has earned award recognition as a Best Malaysian restaurant and offers both dine-in and takeout service.
